title.narrative: Learning Journey on Agroecology & Climate Resilience (Action Research)

description.narrative: The overall aim of this research is to generate practice-based and methodological insights into the relationship between agroecology and climate resilience among smallholder farming communities, while also examining how FAO 's TAPE can be applied and interpreted across diverse programme contexts. BOKU University will accompany CAFOD’s Learning Journey on Agroecology as an embedded action research partner. CAFOD partners will collect data using TAPE-based tools within their programmes, and this research will analyse how these tools function in practice, how agroecological transitions and resilience are measured across contexts, and what methodological challenges and opportunities emerge. Through iterative engagement with the Learning Journey leadership, the research will generate insights that can strengthen the interpretation of the data collected and the broader methodological approaches used to assess agroecological transitions in development programmes.
